attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long spine.** Columns 0 to 28 are spine, carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 89 to 100% of genes there, fewest at column 24, `yhdZ`, named 89% with 0.54 bits.

**Then three variable columns**, 29 to 31, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls. `acrF` is carried by 86% of chromosomes, `acrE` by 89%, `acrS` by 90%. The model names 91 to 94% of genes, fewest at column 29, named 91%, and hesitates most at column 30, 0.64 bits, the most hesitant column of the window.

**A second spine runs from column 32 to 65**, carried by 92 to 97% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 18% of calls. The model names 85 to 99% of genes, fewest at column 39, `accC`, named 85%, and hesitates most at column 41, `yhdH`, 0.42 bits. Column 66, `dcuC`, is variable, carried by 81%, named 96%.

**The `nan` genes follow**, columns 67 to 70, spine, carried by 92 to 93%, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 3% of calls, named 97 to 98%. The last stretch, columns 71 to 79, mixes fork and variable columns and is the most in regions of plasticity: 5 to 35% of calls. The model names 72 to 97% of genes, fewest at column 74, named 72%, and hesitates most at column 73, `yhcG`, 0.60 bits. A second branch of 5 families runs through columns 74 to 78, carried by 29 to 32% of chromosomes, all shell: `yhcF` to `gltF`, [[fimbria and pilus assembly]].

**Across the window the model names 97% of genes**, 0.15 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.80 against 0.11 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 98%. The window ends at column 79, `mtgA`, carried by 30% of chromosomes.

label: rpmD
facts:
WINDOW: the rpmD window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rpmD, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 416 to 495 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rpmD once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.15 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,920 calls, named 99%, 0.08 bits; shell 3,964 calls, named 76%, 0.65 bits; cloud 236 calls, named 40%, 2.22 bits. Outside an RGP 40,848 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; inside an RGP 2,272 calls, named 70%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 67 spine, 7 fork, 6 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.11 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 98%); 2,272 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 30 (acrE) 0.64 bits, RGP 2%; column 73 (yhcG) 0.60 bits, RGP 30%; column 29 (acrF) 0.55 bits, RGP 2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 71-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 5-35%; the least: columns 0-28 (spine), RGP 0-1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-28 (29 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: rpmD, rplO, secY, rpmJ, rpsM, rpsK, rpsD "30S ribosomal protein S4", rpoA, rplQ, yhdN "DUF1992 domain-containing protein", zntR, arfA, mscL, trkA, rsmB, fmt, def, dprA, smg, yrdD "topoisomerase DNA-binding C4 zinc f…", tsaC, aroE, yrdB "DUF1488 domain-containing protein", yrdA "gamma carbonic anhydrase family pro…", yhdZ "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", yhdY "amino acid ABC transporter permease", yhdX "ABC transporter permease subunit", yhdW, yhdV. named 89-100% (mean 99%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 24 (yhdZ), named 89%, 0.54 bits.
2. columns 29-31 (3 columns) variable: RGP 2%. named 91-94% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 29, named 91%; most hesitant at column 30, 0.64 bits.
   29: acrF S 86%
   30: acrE S 89%
   31: acrS P 90% "multidrug efflux transporter transc…"
3. columns 32-65 (34 columns) spine: share 92-97%, all P, RGP 1-18%. Genes: yhdU "DUF2556 family protein", yhdJ "adenine-specific DNA-methyltransfer…", fis, dusB, prmA, panF, yhdT "YhdT family protein", accC, accB "acetyl-CoA carboxylase biotin carbo…", yhdH "alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic dom…", csrD, mreB "rod shape-determining protein MreB", mreC, mreD, yhdE "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospha…", rng, yhdP "YhdP family protein", tldD, aaeR, aaeX "p-hydroxybenzoic acid efflux pump o…", aaeA, aaeB, yhcO "barstar family protein", yhcN "YdgH/BhsA/McbA-like domain containi…", argR, mdh, degS "trypsin-like peptidase domain-conta…", degQ, zapG, zapE "cell division protein ZapE", rplM, rpsI, sspA, sspB "ClpXP protease specificity-enhancin…". named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 39 (accC), named 85%; most hesitant at column 41 (yhdH), 0.42 bits.
4. column 66 variable: RGP 2%. named 96%; 0.21 bits.
   66: dcuC S 81%
5. columns 67-70 (4 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: nanR, nanA "dihydrodipicolinate synthase family…", nanT, nanE. named 97-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 67 (nanR), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 67 (nanR)).
6. columns 71-79 (9 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 5-35%. named 72-97% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 74, named 72%; most hesitant at column 73, 0.60 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 74-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 29-32%, all S; the branch's families: yhcF, "YhcE family protein", yhcD, yhcA, gltF
   71 variable: nanK P 90%
   72 variable: nanQ P 87%
   73 fork: yhcG S 50% "DUF1016 N-terminal domain-containin…"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 19%, "transposase" S 15%
   74 fork: gltD P 73% "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase"
   75 fork: gltB P 55%
   76 fork: yhcC P 49% "TIGR01212 family radical SAM protein"
   77 fork: arcB P 45%
   78 fork: elbB P 42%
   79 fork: mtgA P 30%; also yrbL P 11%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): rpsM 30S ribosomal protein S13; rpsK 30S ribosomal protein S11; acrF efflux RND transporter permease subunit; acrE multidrug efflux RND transporter peripl…; acrS multidrug efflux transporter transcript…; accC biotin carboxylase N-terminal domain-co…; mreC rod shape-determining protein MreC; mreD rod shape-determining protein MreD; aaeR HTH-type transcriptional activator AaeR; aaeA efflux RND transporter periplasmic adap…; degQ trypsin-like peptidase domain-containin…; zapG Z-ring associated protein ZapG; sspA stringent starvation protein SspA; nanE N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate 2-epime…; nanQ YhcH/YjgK/YiaL family protein; gltD FAD-dependent oxidoreductase; gltB glutamate synthase large subunit; yhcD FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-containing…; yhcA fimbria/pilus chaperone family protein; yrbL PhoP regulatory network protein YrbL
END: the window ends at column 79, mtgA, in 30% of chromosomes.
